= FancyBboxPatch((x, y), w, h, boxstyle=\"round,pad=0.015\",\n                         facecolor=fc, edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw, zorder=zorder)\n    if shadow:\n        box.set_path_effects(SHADOW)\n    ax.add_patch(box)\n    if text:\n        ty = y + h * 0.62 if sub else y + h * 0.5\n        ax.text(x + w/2, ty, text, fontsize=fs, fontweight='bold',\n                ha='center', va='center', color=tc, zorder=zorder+1)\n    if sub:\n        ax.text(x + w/2, y + h * 0.27, sub, fontsize=sfs, ha='center',\n                va='center', color=C_GRAY, fontstyle='italic', zorder=zorder+1)\n    return box\n\n\ndef arrow(ax, s, e, color='#AAAAAA', lw=0.8, style='->', ms=10, zorder=3):\n    a = FancyArrowPatch(s, e, arrowstyle=style, color=color, linewidth=lw,\n                        mutation_scale=ms, zorder=zorder)\n    ax.add_patch(a)\n    return a\n\n\nfig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 5.2))\ngs = fig.add_gridspec(1, 3, width_ratios=[1, 1.05, 1], wspace=0.32)\n\n# ms=8)\n\n    # Connector box\n    box = FancyBboxPatch((bx - conn_w/2, conn_y - conn_h/2), conn_w, conn_h,\n                          boxstyle=\"round,pad=0.012\", facecolor='white',\n
